summary.answer: Returns false for a non-arena entry; true for the disabling dvar or non-LAN without an arena season; otherwise false. This is a menu gate, not a whole-mode relevance exclusion. Starts with IsMatchmakingInProgress. Only while true does it check the main mode: Warzone forces false, other modes use not ShowDirectorPrivate(nil,controller). Returns the resulting value. Calls ZombieUtility.ZMOfflineNavigateToCustomGames with the second argument only when the ZombieUtility table exists. The actual call is preserved as a shared helper boundary, not authoring unrelated-mode internals. If either hashed engine predicate is true, only mode_warzone is available. Otherwise availability means GetDisplayNameForEMode is not hash_0. Traverses the supplied widget model→info get value→selectedCharacterType. When that child exists, requests update_frozen_moment_character with its index get value; absent links do nothing. Requests update_frozen_moment_character for the supplied controller with literal index=-1. Receiver delivery and presentation assets are external. Returns whether GetBOPassTierBoost(controller) differs from numeric zero; it does not grant or fetch entitlement itself. summary.answer: Builds a party-count footer. Defines and immediately invokes both private-count and matchmaking-count text functions, then subscribes those same functions to private/game client updates. Matchmaking state tests publicLobby.stage against INVALID and is separately revalidated on stage changes. No party membership changes are implied. Creates self via LUI.UIHorizontalList.new, Label via LUI.UIText.new, Spacer2 via LUI.UIImage.new, Spacer via LUI.UIImage.new, PartyCount via LUI.UIText.new, MatchmakingCount via LUI.UIText.new. Stores state predicates Matchmaking; their body effects require state-system evaluation.
